requirements.title: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC)
requirements.description: Electronic devices must meet FCC Part 15 EMC requirements. Radiated emissions must not exceed Class B limits.

requirements.title: Electrical Safety
requirements.description: Products powered by mains electricity must comply with UL 62368-1 (Audio/Video and IT Equipment Safety).

requirements.title: Battery Safety
requirements.description: Lithium-ion batteries must pass UN 38.3 transportation tests. Devices with batteries must have overcharge protection.

requirements.title: SAR Limits (for wireless devices)
requirements.description: Specific Absorption Rate must not exceed 1.6 W/kg averaged over 1g of tissue for devices used near the body.

requirements.title: Product Labeling
requirements.description: Must include FCC ID, model number, manufacturer info, input voltage/current, and safety warnings in English.

health_wellness_devices.regulation: 21 CFR Part 880 (General Hospital Devices) / Consumer Wellness

requirements.title: Device Classification
requirements.description: Health/wellness devices must be correctly classified. General wellness products (non-diagnostic) may be exempt from 510(k).

requirements.title: Biocompatibility (skin contact)
requirements.description: Materials in prolonged skin contact must pass ISO 10993 biocompatibility testing (cytotoxicity, sensitization, irritation).

requirements.title: Accuracy Claims
requirements.description: Any health measurement claims (heart rate, SpO2, etc.) must be validated with clinical-grade reference devices. Accuracy within ±5%.

requirements.title: Water Resistance Claims
requirements.description: IP rating claims must be validated per IEC 60529. Marketing claims must match tested rating.

requirements.title: Material Safety (RoHS compliance)
requirements.description: Products must not contain lead >100ppm, cadmium >75ppm, or other restricted substances per US state laws.

requirements.title: Charging Safety (for chargers/cables)
requirements.description: USB chargers must have overcurrent, overvoltage, and short-circuit protection. Must comply with USB-IF specifications.

requirements.title: Drop Test / Mechanical Durability
requirements.description: Portable devices must survive 1.2m drop test onto concrete without exposing hazardous components.

requirements.title: California Proposition 65
requirements.description: Products containing any Prop 65 listed chemicals must carry appropriate warning labels.
